requirements.description: arp_eth_rx and arp_eth_tx support DATA_WIDTH=8..512 (including 64 and 256 CYCLE_COUNT==1); arp_eth_rx enforces 28 contiguous kept ARP header bytes without ptr wrap-around, ignores L2 padding, latches tuser across all beats, validates HLEN==6 && PLEN==4, and holds busy until tlast.

arp_cache holds query_response_valid/error/mac stable while !query_response_ready, forwards same-cycle/in-flight bucket writes to concurrent queries, and immediately deasserts request ready signals upon clear_cache.

arp resolves broadcast (/32 safe), RFC 1112 multicast, on-subnet, and off-subnet/zero-gateway targets; validates sender SPA/SHA and applies RFC 826 selective learning + RFC 5227 probe reply; arbitrates Reply vs Request TX without frame loss or handshake mutation; prioritizes hit over timer==0 and holds arp_response stable.

All four modules synthesize without latches or combinational loops at DATA_WIDTH=64 and 256 and pass 4-state gate-level simulation with zero X/Z outputs after rst when initializers and initial blocks are stripped.
